question: Stream E's batch 2 can't land until 86 kinds of stored records each have a keep-rule. E recommends existing rules: rebuildable bookmarks keep the latest 3 (older dropped after 7 days); records of what people did with alerts, concerns and notes kept 7 years; GitHub sign-in history 7 years; plugin hook runs 90 days, but plugin load/permission changes 7 years; persona changes and current alert or panel state keep current plus one earlier version (90 days); dev sessions 30 days; model-usage records 90 days, worktree records 1 year, clarification requests 7 years; wizard and revision records last as long as their chat; background memory upkeep records 7 years. Holds still pause deletion everywhere. Accept all of them?
